Offline reference texts for 命理排盘

Modern plain-language hexagram and line notes:
woakato/astrbot_plugin_divination
https://github.com/woakato/astrbot_plugin_divination
Pinned source commit: d6a46511ed080d6e70006bbd90572e12aee19664
Source file: core/data/gua64.json
License: MIT, as expressly declared in the source repository README.
Only judgment_plain and line plain notes are adapted. The source's medical,
financial and other category predictions are not included.
Short line notes are expanded by project editorial notes recorded in
scripts/fivearts/data/editorial-notes.json.

Classical texts:
The Zhouyi canonical texts are normalized from the existing bundled 易经
chapters 5_1_1_1 through 5_1_1_64. 黄金策 uses the existing nine-volume corpus.
海底眼 is explicitly labeled as selections quoted in the existing 断易天机
and 易隐; it is not represented as a complete independent edition.
火珠林 traditional text: https://zh.wikisource.org/wiki/火珠林
The underlying ancient works are public-domain texts. Source attribution is
retained in the app; modern local annotations retain their original wording.

Additional external reading links only (articles are not copied):
https://www.zhouyi.cc/zhouyi/yijing64/
